page.overview:
Who is Gerd?

Gerd is a giant from Elbaph and the doctor of the New Giant Warrior Pirates. She was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery.

She is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Elbaph Arc.

Gerd is a slender and taller than average giantess with long blonde hair, part of which is kept in two braids on the sides of her head. She has dark brown eyes (blue as a child). She wears a revealing one-piece purple fur garment with a neckline that goes down to her stomach and which leaves the sides of her legs completely exposed. She also wears a very long black and yellow striped stocking on her left leg that nearly goes up to her waist, as well as an eggshell cape with tatters on the bottom and fur boots.

As a child, she had shoulder-length hair and she wore a light blue long-sleeved dress, and has her hair arranged in two braids under a yellow checkered kerchief.
